name: Glen Eichelberger
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Glen Eichelberger is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. He works at Gray Reed, located in Houston, Texas, and provides legal services for issues involving Estate Planning & Probate to the surrounding community.
Glen Eichelberger completed legal studies at University of Houston Law Center and graduated with the class of 1993. Glen Eichelberger passed the bar in 1993.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
